display.purpose: Page titles only. One per page.

motion.name: state-fill
motion.purpose: Hover fill change on buttons; the only motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Inked stamp: the main action of a page.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2a1f10; color: #f8f4ec; padding: 16px 32px; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Thmanyah Sans', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1f150a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b0884b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #2a1f10; padding: 16px 32px; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Thmanyah Sans', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #b0884b; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #efe4d4; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b0884b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Kicker Label
components.description: Gold uppercase Latin kicker with Arabic companion under it.
components.html:
DAR MAKKAH

دار مكة
components.css: .ds-kicker { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-kicker-latin { font-family: 'Thmanyah Sans', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #b0884b; margin: 0; direction: ltr; text-align: right; } .ds-kicker-ar { font-family: 'Thmanyah Sans', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #5c4a25; margin: 0; }

components.name: Medallion
components.description: Signature ornament: 14px double gold ring marking a page header.
components.css: .ds-medallion { display: inline-block; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid #b0884b; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #f8f4ec, inset 0 0 0 4.5px #b0884b; }

components.name: Margin Notes
components.description: Start-ruled annotation column for supporting notes.
components.html: للمعلّمين: أنشئ أسئلك، أطلق جلسة، شارِك الرقم.
components.css: .ds-margin-notes { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; border-inline-start: 1px solid #e6dccb; padding-inline-start: 24px; } .ds-margin-notes p { font-family: 'Thmanyah Sans', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #6b5a36; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview: The system reads like a Quran school teacher's board: a warm parchment surface where structure comes from ruled lines rather than boxes, hierarchy comes from ink weight, and gold appears rarely, only to mark what matters. The interface is calm and legible first; a teacher mid-lesson and a student on a phone should both parse it in one glance. The board is flat: no shadows, no floating cards; the only relief is the medallion's inset ring.
keyCharacteristics: Parchment ground with dark ink type; no pure white, no pure black
Structure from hairline rules, never enclosing boxes
Gold reserved for markers (kickers, medallions, outline borders)
Flat surfaces; the medallion ring is the only relief
Thmanyah families: Serif Display for headings, Sans for UI (planned; system fallbacks until wired)

rules.name: The Gold Ration Rule
rules.body: Gold covers ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is what makes a gold mark read as important.

rules.name: The Board Rule
rules.body: Never a pure white or pure black. The lightest value is parchment, the darkest is ink deep.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: Display type appears once per page; everything else is body scale.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. If a state needs emphasis, change the ink — never add a shadow.

dos: Do structure with hairline start-rules instead of cards and boxes.
Do keep gold to markers and borders; under 10% of any screen.
Do use Thmanyah names in font stacks with the documented fallbacks.
Do anchor layouts to the RTL start edge.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glows, or floating cards.
Don't use pure white or pure black anywhere.
Don't introduce a second display heading size.
Don't let gold become a fill for large surfaces.
